facts.text: The Manor sits on the green, rolling hills south of the Ngorongoro Crater, reached by crossing the Rift Valley.
facts.excerpt: Crossing the Rift Valley and climbing the steppe onto the green and rolling hills south of the Ngorongoro Crater, there lies a truly undeniable surprise

facts.text: The Manor is located adjacent to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area.
facts.excerpt: Located adjacent to the famous Ngorongoro conservation area

facts.text: The Manor stands within a 1500-acre Arabica coffee estate.
The Manor is reminiscent of an elegant up-country farm home in the Cape Dutch style of architecture.
facts.excerpt: The Manor is reminiscent of an elegant up-country farm home in the Cape Dutch-style of architecture

facts.text: The lodge blends East African hospitality with old-world Afro-European architecture and decor.
facts.excerpt: to blend East African hospitality with old-world Afro-European architecture and decor

facts.text: Accommodation is in cottages around a main Manor House, including a family cottage.
facts.excerpt: family cottage, and magnificent main Manor House

facts.text: Each cottage is positioned to maximise views of the adjacent verdant hills while keeping intimacy and privacy.
facts.excerpt: Each of the cottages has been carefully positioned to maximise the views of the adjacent verdant hills but at the same time to maintain the intimacy and privacy of this old-world Manor home.

facts.text: The Manor has gardens set among coffee-bush laden hills.
facts.excerpt: take in the outstanding natural beauty of its gardens and the coffee-bush laden hills

facts.text: Ngorongoro Crater, a short distance away, is an extinct volcano with an 18-kilometre-wide crater floor home to an abundant and unique ecosystem.
facts.excerpt: This extinct volcano - with its 18-kilometre wide crater floor - is home to an abundant and unique ecosystem

facts.text: The Manor has its own restaurant where guests dine after a day at the Crater.
facts.excerpt: you will return to enjoy an incomparable dinner in The Manor’s restaurant

facts.text: The Manor describes itself as one of the first safari lodges of its kind.
facts.excerpt: is one of the first safari lodges of its kind

facts.text: The Manor is located in north west Tanzania.
facts.excerpt: located in the north west Tanzania
